briefdescription.para: Get the absolute path for a project in the temp directory.
Run the initializer with the given arguments.
Assert that basic project structure exists.
Unit tests for the Initializer command (xtc init).

detaileddescription.para:
Tests all flags and options:
<project-name> - required trailing argument
-t, --type - project type (application, library, service)
-m, --multi-module - create multi-module project
